message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine crimes based on facts. Facts: Zhang (defendant) was passenger in car driven by Li. Accident caused death. Li fled. Zhang later was summoned and gave false statement to protect Li, i.e., gave false testimony / false statement to police. That is "提供虚假证据罪" (providing false evidence) or "妨害交通管理罪"? Actually his act is making false statements to police, which is "伪证罪" (perjury) or "提供虚假证据罪". Under Chinese criminal law, giving false statements to police about a crime is "伪证罪" (if in judicial proceedings) or "提供虚假证据罪" (if providing false evidence to law enforcement). The fact says "作虚假证明包庇李某某交通肇事后逃逸的犯罪事实". That is "提供虚假证明罪" (providing false proof). The typical charge: "提供虚假证据罪". Also could be "包庇罪" (concealing a crime) - "帮助逃避法律追究" is "包庇罪". Under Chinese law, "包庇罪" is to conceal a crime, hide the criminal, etc. He gave false statement to protect Li. That could be "包庇罪". However the fact says he made false proof to protect Li's crime. That is both providing false evidence and concealment. Usually prosecutors charge "提供虚假证据罪" for false statements to police. Also "包庇罪" requires concealment of a crime, not necessarily false statement. He is actively lying to police, which is false evidence. So answer likely: [罪名]提供虚假证据罪<eoa>.
